text: Maya (PM): Usability run flagged inconsistent language between the console and docs: the action in the model row says 'Tag' while the docs call it 'Version' and the deep link goes to #pinning. Users are confused. Ethan (Design): We shortened to 'Tag' for the table, but agree 'Version' is clearer. Propose visible label 'Version' and a compact adjacent link 'How to pin' that targets the pinning section. Nina (Docs): Docs canonical term is 'model version'. I'll add an explicit H2 id '#pinning' and a small alias anchor '' before it so legacy fragments still land correctly. I'll also add a one-line note at the top: "Console label: Version (previously 'Tag')" and search synonyms for 'tag'. Lee (Eng): Implementation notes: changing the label is trivial. Keep telemetry event name as model_tag_click to avoid dashboard churn, but map label -> event in the UI layer. Fragments are client-side, so adding the hidden anchor is the right approach. Also will add aria-label to the inline link: 'How to pin a model version'. Ethan (Design): Accessibility: tooltip copy should be keyboard accessible and use aria-describedby. Inline link text should be descriptive for screen readers. I'll upload revised copy to the Figma file. Nina (Docs): I'll open a PR for the anchors and glossary alias today. Lee (Eng): I'll create a tiny feature branch for the UI text change and add an e2e that clicks the inline link, asserts URL fragment is '#pinning' and focus lands on the H2. AssistBot: checklist: docs-pr: open soon, ui-branch: created, qa: TEST-5012. Maya (PM): Thanks — aim to ship in the upcoming minor. Ping here when PRs are ready or if any unexpected regressions show up.
